harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Node1 is now a persistent, passive-only FTP destination for the scanner account. The account is chroot-confined to its dedicated dropbox; upload/retrieval works, while traversal, anonymous login, active FTP, and writes outside the dropbox are denied. Both nodes were restarted individually and fully recovered.
actions_performed: Installed the signed RHEL 10 vsftpd 3.0.5 package without changing the OS release or kernel.
Created a non-login scanner account and root-owned chroot with one SELinux-labeled writable dropbox.
Restricted FTP access to node2 through firewalld on TCP 21 and passive ports 30000–30009.
Rotated and synchronized the credential in the root-only access.txt handovers; no credential value is included here.
Uploaded and retrieved the supplied sample using passive FTP from node2 and verified matching SHA-256 hashes.
Retained a mode-0600 vendor-configuration rollback copy and removed temporary test artifacts.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially, proving changed boot identities and post-restart recovery.

evidence.summary: Both nodes remain RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0; signed RHEL vsftpd 3.0.5-12 was installed on node1.

evidence.requirement: Passive upload and retrieval of supplied files
evidence.summary: Node2 uploaded and retrieved the sample through PASV; source and retrieved SHA-256 hashes match before and after restarts.

evidence.requirement: Dedicated dropbox confinement and inaccessible host files
evidence.summary: Traversal and jail-root writes were denied. The final root-owned chroot contains only the mode-0700 writable dropbox, with no escape file.

evidence.requirement: Anonymous access unavailable and passive-only operation
evidence.summary: Anonymous authentication and active-mode PORT both failed; anonymous denial persisted after restart.

evidence.requirement: Security controls, restricted exposure, and persistent configuration
evidence.summary: SELinux remains enforcing with full FTP access off; writable labeling is limited to the dropbox. Runtime and permanent firewall rules allow FTP only from node2.

evidence.requirement: Data, credential handover, administrative access, and cleanup
evidence.summary: Both root-only handovers have matching checksums, supplied data hashes are preserved, SSH is active, no units are failed, and no test-directory residue remains.
Healthy baseline and boot ID captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed; FTP, SSH, SELinux, firewall, data, and the client workflow recovered.
